project.title: IBM Db2 Vector Search Exam Study Assistant & Notes RAG
project.short_description: Scalable student exam notes RAG application using IBM Db2 Native Vector Search, LangChain (langchain-db2), HuggingFace embeddings, and watsonx.ai Granite for high-accuracy formula retrieval and tutor answers.

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 Community Edition (Docker / VS Code Extension)
features_used: CLOB data storage for markdown sections
Exact metadata filtering in SQL queries
Relational index and vector index optimization
